title: Blank form field map
description: Describes what a blank official form asks for and where on the page each answer goes. Computed once per form by tools/build-formmap.mjs, served as a static public file, and joined to the user's local profile on their device. It contains no user data and never will — that is the whole reason Track B needs no server at request time.

form_id.description: Stable slug, e.g. 'btl_child_allowance_5020'. Never reused for a different form.

revision_date.description: The revision date printed on the form itself, when it has one. Agencies reissue forms; this is how a stale map is spotted.

page_size.description: Coordinate space for every box below. Origin is top-left.

he.description: The label printed next to the box, verbatim.

type.description: Drives on-device validation. 'id_number' runs the ת״ז check digit before printing.

profile_key.description: Which local profile field answers this. null means the user must type it — the fill engine never invents a value.
profile_key.$comment: Must exist in the profile model owned by workstream E. CI validates the reference.

choices.description: For 'choice': each option has its own tick box.

direction.description: Hebrew names run rtl; account numbers and Latin names run ltr in the same form. Getting this wrong prints the value backwards.

boxed_digits.description: Israeli forms print one square per digit. When set, the engine distributes characters across that many evenly spaced cells inside the box instead of rendering a run of text.
